name: Daridorexant

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS CNS-Depressant Effects and Daytime Impairment: Impairs alertness and motor coordination including morning impairment. Risk increases when used with other central nervous system (CNS) depressants. For patients taking QUVIVIQ, caution against next-day driving and other activities requiring…

summary: This drug has a warning that it can impair alertness, motor coordination, and daytime functioning the next morning, with higher risk if combined with other central nervous system depressants, which slow down brain activity [3]. Patients taking this medication are cautioned against next-day driving and other activities that require full attention [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a medium risk score of 61 for the liver [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low risk score of 33 for the heart [M].
